headline: Google Wallet launches on iOS without tap-to-pay
summary: Google Wallet is launching on iOS, bringing Gemini agentic shopping to US-based iPhone users, but the app does not support tap-to-pay.

claims.statement: Google Wallet is launching on iOS.
